findings.problem: /tutorials/<entry> scrolls the PAGE sideways at 390: the document renders 465px wide in a 390px viewport, 75px of overflow, from an unbroken inline code URL token. R2 is constitutional under K14 and this breaks it on a live route; the reflow check samples four fixed routes, none of them this one.
findings.invariant: At every declared viewport document.scrollWidth equals clientWidth on EVERY exported route, /tutorials/<entry> included; the reflow sample is widened past its four fixed routes, not patched per route.
findings.prescription: overflow-wrap:anywhere on inline code inside .prose, plus a widened reflow route list.

findings.problem: .entry-rails' two heading rules each span their grid track (292.0px) instead of the block each introduces (130.0px, 216.0px), leaving 162.0px and 76.0px of overhang on the wiki entry template.
findings.invariant: Each .entry-rails section's heading border-top spans that section's own widest rendered child within 1px; S5's route list includes .entry-rails.
findings.prescription: width:fit-content on each rail section, the remedy R10's iter-08 addendum applied to .rail-posts.

findings.problem: S18's wiki-entry clause was retired as having no track left to ask about, but .entry-rails on the same template is still a two-column grid at 44.9% (61.0px against 136.0px), under R13's 60% floor. The shape the clause governed survived its retirement.
findings.invariant: The shorter of .entry-rails' two columns reaches 60% of the taller, or the grid collapses to one fit-content flow; S18 samples every declared two-column grid, not one named pair.
findings.prescription: Collapse .entry-rails to one flow, or let the shorter rail's content set the row.

findings.problem: /frontier's VENDOR CLAIM chip is identical on 16 of 16 rows and drawn as a bordered chip, louder than the price and context columns compared across. R8 boxes only a tone that differs from the collection default, and S17's 90% rule is scoped to three routes that exclude /frontier.
findings.invariant: No column of /frontier's board renders a value identical on more than 90% of rows at or above the computed weight of the compared columns, and no badge is boxed at the default tone; S17's route list includes /frontier.
findings.prescription: State 'claimed, unverified' once above the board; render the per-row cell unboxed at --muted, keeping the chip where a row's claim state differs.

findings.problem: The board's rightmost column is unreadable at the widest viewport: at 1440 all 16 VENDOR CLAIM cells are clipped mid-sentence at the container edge; at 768 the column is off-screen. The packet promises the whole field on one screen; an uncapped prose cell in the last track prevents it, and no invariant bounds a board column's right edge.
findings.invariant: At 1440 the board's rightmost declared column renders fully inside its container's visible width; below that a clipped column is capped to a token or dropped with its absence stated.
findings.prescription: Cap the claim cell to a short token (the chip plus a date) and move the sentence to the model record.

diagnosis.strongest: TABL on the catalog: the 390 record form cuts the page from 93,963px to a measured 48,520px while the collection grew to 431 rows, and the 1440 table holds its header corridor and quiets its Read column.
diagnosis.weakest: RESP. A page-level horizontal scroll is live at 390 on /tutorials/<entry> (465px document), 768 is a squeezed desktop on /catalog, and a sub-floor dead track survived on the wiki entry.
diagnosis.critical_issue: Q4 fails: /tutorials/<entry> renders 465px wide at a 390px viewport, breaking R2, constitutional under K14. verify-design misses it because it samples four fixed routes.
diagnosis.highest_value_improvement: Widen the four scoped checks — verify-design's reflow list, S5, S17, S18 — to sample EVERY template rather than the routes the closing item happened to name. That one change catches F-struct-1 through F-struct-4 together, and it is the fourth recurrence of this shape after I35, I36, I40 and I41: the rule text was never scoped to one route, only the check was.

downstream.weakness: Every structural defect this round sits on a template some green check does not sample; none contradicts a rule's own text.
downstream.cause: Checks inherit their route list from the verdict item that closed them, so a site-wide rule is enforced route-wise and each new template arrives outside every list.
downstream.recommendation: Derive each invariant's route list from the rendered route manifest plus an explicit exclusion list, so adding a template (/frontier) adds it to every check naming its shape.
